verdicts.reason: Asking whether this is a first consultation is a sensible opening step after a booking request.
Asks what the user wants help with, which the user already described in turn 1.
Asks whether the user has a doctor in mind right after the user named Dr. Meera Rao.
Accepts the named doctor and moves on to asking which days work.
Accepts the doctor switch and re-asks the still unanswered days question.
Says no evening slots match and offers alternative slots with the chosen doctor.
Confirms the booking for the option the user picked.
